descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S06 「任务怎么得到它的状态 × 模式 → 它在界面上和 Copy Text 里出现在哪」 How a task got its state × context → where it shows on the screen and in Copy Text

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Standard fixture (one Hospital patient, one Nursing Home resident); the agent adds four tasks by hand on each chart

When A stays open; B is ticked done on the Task Export screen; C is ticked done on the chart's Post-Round tab; D is ticked done and then undone on Task Export; then Copy Text (read by the scripted step). Same in Nursing Home

Then Table: open (A) → pending under its patient; done on Task Export (B) → completed at the bottom; done on the chart (C) → completed at the bottom; done then undone (D) → pending, not completed. Copy Text follows the same table

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Decision table from U2/U3. Each view checkpoint: mustContain A–D and the patient; A and D before B and C (mustAppearInOrder, one patient, so Q5-neutral). Each clipboard checkpoint (capture: scripted): same; B and C missing reported as known (PR #106), also in the pairs that name them (oracleRules 1)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
